# Self-hosted WebLLM runtime

`webllm-0.2.89.js` is a bundled/minified copy of @mlc-ai/web-llm 0.2.89, produced with esbuild 0.25.12. It is loaded only in the explicitly enabled Browser AI worker. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and WEBLLM_LICENSE. Model weights are not included. See BROWSER_AI.md for reproduction and runtime/model asset origins.
